integrity: The source matrix identities, Jordan dimensions, periodic counts and basin formulas have been derived explicitly, and independently built finite matrix powers and full small-order trajectories have been checked.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the complete three-uniform point-triple incidence graph, unweighted simultaneous neighbor sums, and characteristic two; no priority or independent verification is claimed. Finite computation corroborates the all-order algebraic proof but is not a substitute for it.
title: Four-residue extinction and two-cycle phases on complete triple-incidence graphs
